vendor_normalization.fuzzy_method: difflib SequenceMatcher ratio >= 0.93 within identical-first-token blocks

corp_match.method: exact match of normalized vendor key against normalized corp legal names
corp_match.caveat: match is against FEDERAL corporations only; provincially-incorporated vendors (e.g. Irving Shipbuilding, Vancouver Shipyards) do not match even when the company is real

canadabuys_join.rule: normalized supplier name equality AND rounded-dollar amount equality AND award date within 120 days; CAD only
canadabuys_join.caveat: CanadaBuys contract history covers PWGSC-awarded contracts on behalf of departments; TBS proactive publication covers all departments' self-reported contracts. ID namespaces differ (contractNumber vs procurement_id), so the join is probabilistic.
canadabuys_join.per_fiscal_year_files_skipped: redundant: complete (2023-06-01+) + historical (2009-2023-05-31) cover the full span with identical restructured schema

canadian_vs_foreign.label: matched vendors resolved to CA-registered federal corporations (all matched were CA); unmatched vendors origin unknown - no country guessed

tbs_declared_country_supplementary.note: department-declared country_of_vendor per contract (separate re-scan); 18.5% blank

parent_layer.missing_source: No free bulk source of ultimate corporate parents exists. StatCan Inter-Corporate Ownership (Corporations Returns Act) is the authoritative who-owns-what source but is a paid, threshold-based product (~45,000 corps), not bulk open data. The federal Individuals with Significant Control register is not bulk-published. The ISED Federal Corporations CSV has no parent field.
parent_layer.verified_parents_csv: data/verified_parents.csv - top 5 vendors manually verified from official/press sources, excluded from automated aggregates
